en: The Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Sūtra for Saving from Suffering.

Homage to the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara Who Saves from Suffering. To the hundreds of thousands of millions of buddhas, to the buddhas as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, to the buddhas of immeasurable merit.
The Buddha addressed Ānanda, saying: "This sūtra of the Great Sage is able to save those imprisoned in hell; it is able to save those [in grave suffering]..."

Illness. It can rescue one from a thousand calamities and a hundred hardships. If there is anyone who can recite this one thousand times, that person shall be freed from suffering and hardship for their entire life.
If they recite it ten thousand times, the whole family shall be freed from suffering and hardship. Homage to the Buddha’s Power and Majesty! Homage to the Buddha’s Power and Protection!
May it cause people to have no evil thoughts and enable those who practice it to attain liberation in this very body. Bodhisattva Who Turns Back the Light; Bodhisattva Who Turns Back to Goodness. A.
Nuo Da Tian Wang (Virūḍhaka), the Great Heavenly King; the Bodhisattvas of the Main Hall; mo qiū mo qiū (māki māki); pure Bhikṣus. May official matters be resolved and private affairs come to rest.
May all the Great Bodhisattvas and five hundred Arhats protect the bodies of their disciples, so that they may all be freed from suffering and hardship.
Spontaneously, Avalokiteśvara will appear; there is no need to untie the jeweled necklaces. Recite diligently ten million times, and disasters will naturally [cease].
Thus one attains liberation. Believe, accept, and practice accordingly.
Then he spoke the mantra: Jinapūte jinabodhi | dhāraṇīte nikharate | bodhi svāhā ||
